description: A heart-shaped blossom rises on a straight stem from a rounded vase with a narrow neck. Two pointed leaves branch symmetrically below the blossom, above the vase's flared shoulders and flat base.
A single rose leans right on a curved stem emerging from a round narrow-necked vase. One pointed leaf extends left, and a curved line across the bud describes its folded petals.
An upright rose has a cup-shaped bloom formed by overlapping curved petals. Two pointed leaves spread from opposite sides of a straight stem beneath the flower, with the stem continuing downward.
A round gemstone sits atop a broad circular ring band shown from the front. The band surrounds a large open center, with a small four-point sparkle on either side of the stone.
A faceted diamond sits above the arched upper portion of a ring band. The gem has a broad flat top and pointed bottom, with triangular facet divisions meeting at the setting.
A small bouquet is gathered into a tapered wrapper with a short flared base. A heart-shaped blossom rises at the upper left and a rounded bud leans right above overlapping wrapping edges.
A broad heart outline has rounded upper lobes and a pointed lower tip. Three horizontal lines cross the shape, dividing its face into four stacked bands that narrow toward the bottom.
An open hand faces forward with five spread fingers and a thumb extending left. A broad bracelet encircles the wrist, with rounded ends projecting beyond both sides of the forearm.
A central heart-shaped bloom rises above two smaller hearts on outward-curving branches. The three stems meet over a shallow rectangular planter with a broad rim and two short feet.
The word LOVE is arranged in a two-by-two square, with a heart replacing the upper-right O. A straight L occupies the upper left, while V and E fill the lower row.
A heart-shaped blossom tops a straight vertical stem. Two pointed leaves curve outward symmetrically from the middle, while the stem continues below them to form a complete upright sprig.
A short pillar candle sits in a shallow rounded holder, with a heart-shaped flame above its wick. An uneven wax-drip line crosses the candle's upper face and descends along the left side.
A heart is pierced diagonally from lower left to upper right by an arrow. The pointed arrowhead projects beyond the right lobe, while feathered fletching extends behind the lower-left edge.
A heart-shaped balloon narrows to a small triangular knot beneath its pointed base. A loose string descends from the knot in a gentle wavering curve, below the evenly rounded upper lobes.
Two heart-shaped balloons overlap, with a larger one at the upper left and a smaller one lower on the right. Separate curved strings descend from their pointed bases.
Two mirrored cupped hands rise from below to cradle a large heart between them. The fingers curl inward beneath the heart's lower point, while the outer fingers extend upright at either side.
An open hand extends from the left with its palm facing upward beneath a large heart. The fingers curve toward the upper right, and an inner line marks the folded thumb across the palm.
A heart-shaped blossom rises from a small tapered flowerpot with a thick rim. One pointed leaf branches left from the straight stem, which connects the bloom to the pot below.
A straight stem rises from a small square pot and branches into three hearts. The central heart is largest and highest, while two smaller tilted hearts sit on asymmetrical side branches.
A circular head sits above a large heart-shaped torso. The heart's rounded lobes suggest shoulders around a central notch, and its sides taper to a pointed lower body.
A circular head sits above a large heart-shaped torso. The heart's rounded lobes suggest shoulders around a central notch, and its sides taper to a pointed lower body.
A raised hand faces forward with four close upright fingers and a thumb spreading left. A curved crease crosses the base of the thumb, and a straight rectangular wristband wraps the forearm.
A heart-shaped balloon has broad rounded lobes and a tapered lower point. A small triangular knot connects it to a straight vertical string descending beneath the center.
A bride and groom stand side by side facing forward. The groom wears a shirt and trousers, while the bride has center-parted hair beneath a long veil and a dress with a pointed neckline.
A wide single-tier cake supports two small standing figures on top. A scalloped icing border runs across the upper face, and the rectangular cake body has rounded lower corners.
Three stacked cake tiers decrease in width toward the top. Each tier has rounded upper corners and a wavy icing band across its face, with the widest tier resting on a horizontal base.
A right-facing car carries a heart-shaped balloon tethered to its rear by a curved string. A heart decorates the side, while two round wheels and trailing ribbons or cans sit beneath the body.
A sleeveless wedding dress has a fitted bodice with a pointed neckline and a narrow waist. A wide flared skirt expands toward a gently curved hem, forming a vertically balanced silhouette.
Three five-pointed stars form a burst with one above two lower side stars. A straight central trail and two outward-curving side trails rise toward the stars from below.
